mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_file_pass (file_id, pass, revision_id, status) SELECT file_id, #{pass}, revision_id , CASE WHEN parse_status = 'SKIPPED' THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE 'PENDING' END FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = #{language} ON CONFLICT (file_id, pass) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT f.file_id AS "fileId" , f.path AS "path" , f.module AS "module" , f.source_root AS "sourceRoot" , f.language AS "language" , f.file_type AS "fileType" , f.package_name AS "packageName" , f.encoding AS "encoding" , f.language_level AS "languageLevel" , f.parse_status AS "parseStatus" FROM analysis_file_pass p JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = p.file_id WHERE p.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND p.pass = #{pass} AND p.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY p.file_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT pass AS "pass" , status AS "status" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" FROM analysis_file_pass WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY pass, status ORDER BY pass, status
